resources.string: Could not get the location right now.
SOS: I need help. I am here: %1$s
SOS active: sending the location for 30 minutes
Permission to read the contacts is needed.
There are no favorite contacts.\nStar (★) the people who should appear here in the Contacts app.
WhatsApp is not installed on this phone.
No favorite is marked as having WhatsApp.\nMark them in the caregiver settings (clock 5 s → PIN → \"Have WhatsApp\").
The PINs do not match. Start again.
The same order in Call and in Video call. New favorites appear at the end.
Can request the location by SMS
Tick it if that person uses WhatsApp: they will appear in the video call button.
Separated by commas. Capital letters, accents and punctuation do not matter.
On: WhatsApp calls are shown on the large screen.
The app is not Device Owner: kiosk mode is not active.
Kiosk mode is left until you come back to this app.
Paused: the phone works normally (also after restarting). Turn it back on when you finish.
On. Pausing it lets you install or set up things; it is turned back on here, without a computer.
Only to uninstall the launcher or give the phone to someone else:
Free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify it under the terms of the GNU Affero General Public License, version 3 or later. It comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.

Kiosk mode will be turned off for good. Turning it back on requires a computer (adb) and removing all accounts from the phone first (Google, WhatsApp…). If you only want to install or set up something, use \"Pause kiosk mode\".

Change the order and size of the buttons, or hide the ones that are not used. Small and medium buttons take half a row; large ones, the whole row. The clock is always shown: holding it down is the way into this panel.
Choose the one the person recognizes best. Whatever the picture, it has to be held down for 2 seconds.
Off: the phone only uses the mobile network of the SIM. Nobody can turn it on except from here.
On: the phone connects to the saved Wi-Fi networks. Choose or add networks in the Android settings.
The app is not Device Owner: Wi-Fi is managed from the Android settings.
The caregiver has not marked the house yet.

Turn on the \"Go home\" button in Home screen and mark the house here. The button shows the address in large letters, so the person can show it to the police or to someone in the street, and an arrow that starts the walking route of Google Maps with voice. Tap \"Try the route\" once and accept the first screens of Google Maps, so the person never sees them.
The house is not marked yet.
Use my current location (I am at the house)
The location could not be obtained. Go outside or near a window and try again.
Location saved, but the address could not be found: write it by hand.
It is shown in large letters. Add the floor and door if needed.
Find this address on the map
That address was not found. Check it or use the current location.
GO HOME: the button to go home has been pressed. Location: %1$s
GO HOME: the button to go home has been pressed. The location could not be obtained.
Warn by SMS when the button is pressed

It is sent to the SOS contact, with the location and the battery. When the person arrives near the house following the route, the photo of the door is shown with a button to go back to the home screen.
The photo could not be saved. Try again.
Take a photo of the door
Choose a photo from the gallery
Send the location every 10 minutes during the route

From the moment the person starts the route (green arrow) until arriving home, the SOS contact receives an SMS with the location every 10 minutes, and a last one on arrival. It stops by itself after 2 hours at most.
GO HOME: on the way, %2$d m from home. Location: %1$s
GO HOME: on the way. The location could not be obtained.
Depending on the contract of the phone line, sending SMS may be charged and increase the bill. Check with the operator that the plan includes SMS before turning it on.
Sends SMS: depending on the phone plan, they may be charged.

Besides the Contacts app, contacts can be managed from any phone or computer: go to contacts.google.com with the Google account of this phone, create the contact with name, photo and phone number, and mark it with the star (★). It arrives in a few minutes (it needs mobile data or Wi-Fi). Then tick \"Have WhatsApp\" here if needed. Tip: use an account only for this phone; with yours, your own favorite contacts would also appear.
There is no Google account on the phone.
Automatic sync of the phone is off: changes will not arrive by themselves.
Syncing… changes appear in a few minutes.
Choose what the person recognizes best to leave a screen: the large house at the top, which goes back to the home screen, or a fixed arrow at the bottom left, like the Android back button but larger.

Turn on the \"WhatsApp (chats)\" button in Home screen so the person can use the whole of WhatsApp: chats, voice notes, photos and videos. The button shows a red number with the new messages. While WhatsApp is open, a small tab with a house on the right edge of the screen goes back to LlamaditApp. Inside kiosk mode, web links and other apps do not open.
The button to go back over WhatsApp is allowed.
The button to go back over WhatsApp needs the permission \"Display over other apps\". Without it, WhatsApp opens anyway and the person must leave it with the back arrow.
Allow the button to go back

Turn on the \"Exercises\" button in Home screen and choose which exercises the person can do. Each one starts at the level you choose (1 = very easy): after 5 rounds in a row done well it goes up a level, and after 3 with mistakes it goes down. The exercises change every time. \"Who is it?\" uses the photos of the favourite contacts, and the puzzle too. The exercises are silent except \"Who is it?\", which speaks: the media volume goes up while the person plays.
To play \"Who is it?\", at least 2 favourite contacts need a photo.
The caregiver has not chosen any exercise yet.
